summary: Design secure CI/CD, IaC, and container controls with practical DevSecOps exercises. Explore the course and build your delivery roadmap.
lede: DevSecOps training for cloud-native engineering helps DevOps, platform, and security professionals integrate security controls into software delivery pipelines. Participants map controls to CI/CD stages, check Terraform infrastructure-as-code with Checkov, and review container risks with Trivy. They also develop secrets-management workflows and compliance evidence maps, while SLSA provenance, CycloneDX software bills of materials, and policy-as-code receive guided introduction rather than production deployment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who build, secure, govern, or oversee cloud-native software delivery. It suits people who work with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, containers, and software assurance controls.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with software development or IT operations, cloud concepts, and CI/CD workflows is recommended. Prior experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, or security tooling will help, but the course uses guided examples. Coding is not required; you will review sample configuration and pipeline artefacts. Advanced topics such as SLSA provenance and policy-as-code are introduced and applied at an operational design level, not taught as production engineering.
